quests.instruction: Which word do parents use to describe their own girl child?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: This word is used from the parents' point of view, not the siblings'.
quests.explanation: Daughter is the word parents use to describe their own girl child.
quests.funFact: Parents often say the words 'my daughter' with a lot of pride and love!

quests.instruction: Which family member calls your parent 'Aunt' or 'Uncle'?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: This relative is the child of your parent's own sibling.
quests.explanation: Cousin is the family member who calls your parent 'Aunt' or 'Uncle'.
quests.funFact: Family names can go both ways — you might be called 'cousin' by them too!

quests.instruction: Which family member do your cousins call 'Mom'?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: From your point of view, she is your parent's own sister.
quests.explanation: Aunt is the family member that your cousins call 'Mom', since she is their own mother.
quests.funFact: The same person can be called different family names — a mom to her own kids and an aunt to yours!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a man in your parents' generation, but is not your father?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He is your mother's or father's own brother.
quests.explanation: Uncle is a man in your parents' generation who is not your father — he is your parent's brother.
quests.funFact: An uncle often loves teaching nieces and nephews fun new games or skills!

quests.instruction: Which word do parents use to describe their own boy child?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: Think about the pride in a parent's voice saying this word.
quests.explanation: Son is the word parents use to describe their own boy child.
quests.funFact: Parents often say the words 'my son' with a lot of pride and love!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the man that your aunt or uncle also calls 'Dad'?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He is the father of your parent and of your aunt or uncle too.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is the man that your aunt or uncle also calls 'Dad', since he is their father too.
quests.funFact: A grandfather can be the father of several of your aunts, uncles, and your own parent all at once!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the woman that your aunt or uncle also calls 'Mom'?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She is the mother of your parent and of your aunt or uncle too.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is the woman that your aunt or uncle also calls 'Mom', since she is their mother too.
quests.funFact: A grandmother can be the mother of several of your aunts, uncles, and your own parent all at once!

quests.instruction: Which word includes your parents, siblings, grandparents, aunts, uncles, and cousins, all together?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word is the biggest umbrella term of all.
quests.explanation: Family includes your parents, siblings, grandparents, aunts, uncles, and cousins, all together.
quests.funFact: A big family reunion is a fun way for all these different relatives to gather in one place!

quests.instruction: Which family member group is the parent generation of your own mother and father?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This group raised your mom and dad.
quests.explanation: Grandparents are the parent generation of your own mother and father.
quests.funFact: Each of your parents has their own set of parents, meaning you could have up to four grandparents!

quests.instruction: Which family member group is one generation below your grandparents?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This group are the children of your grandparents.
quests.explanation: Parents are one generation below your grandparents, since your parents are your grandparents' own children.
quests.funFact: Your parent is both a child to your grandparents and a parent to you, all at the same time!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a sister, but seen from her own parents' point of view instead of her siblings'?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: The same girl is called this word by her mom and dad.
quests.explanation: Daughter describes the same girl who is a sister to her siblings, but seen from her parents' point of view.
quests.funFact: One single person can hold many family titles at once, like daughter, sister, and granddaughter!

quests.instruction: Which family member is connected to you through your extended family, rather than your own household?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: This relative's parent is your aunt or uncle.
quests.explanation: Cousin is connected to you through your extended family, rather than through your own household.
quests.funFact: The word 'extended family' describes relatives beyond just parents, siblings, and grandparents!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the sister of your mother or your father?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: Her children, if she has any, would be your cousins.
quests.explanation: Aunt is the sister of your mother or your father.
quests.funFact: In some families, close family friends are also lovingly called 'Aunt' even without being related by blood!

quests.instruction: Whose children would also be your cousins, if he has any?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: Think of your parent's own brother.
quests.explanation: Your uncle's children, if he has any, are your cousins.
quests.funFact: Cousins often love comparing stories about their favorite uncles at family parties!

quests.instruction: Which word describes what a father might proudly call his own boy?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: Think of what a proud parent calls their child, not what a sibling calls them.
quests.explanation: Son is what a father might proudly call his own boy.
quests.funFact: Fathers and sons often bond over favorite shared hobbies and activities!

quests.instruction: Which family member might tell you stories about what your own mother or father was like as a child, but is a man?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He raised your mom or dad many years ago.
quests.explanation: Grandfather might tell you stories about what your mother or father was like as a child, since he raised them.
quests.funFact: Listening to a grandfather's stories is a wonderful way to learn about your family's history!

quests.instruction: Which family member might tell you stories about what your own mother or father was like as a child?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She raised your mom or dad many years ago.
quests.explanation: Grandmother might tell you stories about what your mother or father was like as a child, since she raised them.
quests.funFact: Listening to a grandmother's stories is a wonderful way to learn about your family's history!

quests.instruction: Which word describes everyone related to you, from your closest relatives to your more distant ones?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word covers your whole web of relatives, near and far.
quests.explanation: Family describes everyone related to you, from your closest relatives to your more distant ones.
quests.funFact: Some people trace their family back many generations to learn about relatives from long ago!

quests.instruction: Which family member group would you likely visit alongside cousins, aunts, and uncles at a big family gathering?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This is the generation above your own parents.
quests.explanation: Grandparents are often the family member group everyone gathers around at big family events.
quests.funFact: Big family gatherings often center around a grandparent's home or a grandparent's special occasion!

quests.instruction: Which family member group do you live with at home and call 'Mom' and 'Dad'?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This group is directly responsible for raising you.
quests.explanation: Parents are the family member group you live with and call 'Mom' and 'Dad'.
quests.funFact: Most children spend more everyday time with their parents than with any other relative!

quests.instruction: Which word means a female child, whether she is an only child or has many siblings?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: This word works whether or not the girl has any siblings.
quests.explanation: Daughter means a female child, whether she is an only child or has many siblings.
quests.funFact: Being an 'only child' means having no brothers or sisters, but you are still someone's son or daughter!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a child of your parent's sibling?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: Your parent's own brother or sister is this relative's parent.
quests.explanation: Cousin is a child of your parent's sibling, meaning your aunt or uncle.
quests.funFact: Cousins can be older, younger, or even the exact same age as you!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a woman in your parents' generation, but is not your mother?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She is your mother's or father's own sister.
quests.explanation: Aunt is a woman in your parents' generation who is not your mother — she is your parent's sister.
quests.funFact: An aunt can sometimes feel like a second mom, offering love and support too!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a man who is your parent's own sibling?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He is in the same generation as your mother and father.
quests.explanation: Uncle is a man who is your parent's own sibling.
quests.funFact: You might have several uncles if your mom and dad each have more than one brother!

quests.instruction: Which word means a male child, whether he is an only child or has many siblings?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: This word works whether or not the boy has any siblings.
quests.explanation: Son means a male child, whether he is an only child or has many siblings.
quests.funFact: An only child grows up without siblings at home, but is still fully someone's son or daughter!

quests.instruction: Which word describes what a mother might proudly call her own girl?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: Think of a title used only by a parent, never by a sibling.
quests.explanation: Daughter is what a mother might proudly call her own girl.
quests.funFact: Mothers and daughters often bond over favorite shared hobbies and activities!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your own age group, but is not part of your immediate household?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: This relative lives with your aunt or uncle instead.
quests.explanation: Cousin is your own age group, but they live with your aunt or uncle rather than in your own home.
quests.funFact: Cousins from far away sometimes become pen pals, writing letters or messages to stay close!

quests.instruction: Which family member is one generation above you, a woman, but not one of your two parents?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She is your mother's or father's sister.
quests.explanation: Aunt is one generation above you and a woman, but she is not one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Aunts often love spoiling their nieces and nephews with extra treats and fun outings!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your parent's brother, whether on your mom's side or your dad's side?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He could come from either side of your family.
quests.explanation: Uncle is your parent's brother, whether he comes from your mom's side or your dad's side.
quests.funFact: Different languages sometimes use different words for an uncle on your mom's side versus your dad's side!

quests.instruction: Which word means a boy who is someone's very own child?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: This word is used only by that boy's own mother or father.
quests.explanation: Son means a boy who is someone's very own child.
quests.funFact: The bond between a parent and their son often grows and changes as the son grows older!
